unresolved.note: yugeninfra.com gives no possession date for Garden of Eden or the villas. The MahaRERA project page (maharerait.maharashtra.gov.in/public/project/view/61381) that holds the proposed completion date is behind a CAPTCHA, so the RERA completion date could not be read.

PP1310002501906 is confirmed (builder site: 'MahaRERA Registration | PP1310002501906'; MahaRERA registry lists GARDEN OF EDEN, Yugen Infra Private Limited, Sindhudurg). It covers the Garden of Eden plotted project only, not the whole township. No other registration is shown by the builder.

Our ₹99.9 L (200 sq yd plot) is not published by the builder; the builder's current figure is ₹1.55 Cr (recorded above). The builder's own page is internally inconsistent: visible text says plots from 300 sq yd and ₹1.55 Cr, a card says 200-500 sq yd, and meta/schema text says 'Starting ₹45 Lakhs'. No builder price for Acqua Front Villas, Golf Drive farmhouses or apartments.

Builder's founder (press-media page) says 'Just 18–19 km from MOPA Airport ... 20-minute drive via National Highway 66'; the project page says '15 min' to Mopa. Our '5 km (aerial)' / 'next to' the airport is not supported by builder material.
Builder marks Garden of Eden 'Ongoing'. The Golfer's Paradise page (yugeninfra.com/golfers-paradise/) now returns 404, so the 'Phase I sold out' claim is no longer on the builder site.
